title: Design System: Tribe Health FHIR Server Docs

title.purpose: h2 section headings under a hairline rule.

body.purpose: Prose in Source Serif 4, capped at 68ch.

label.purpose: Uppercase document chrome: table headers, admonition headings, TOC label.

code.purpose: Code fields and inline code only.

shadows.name: sheet
shadows.purpose: The one paper elevation, on the doc page only.

motion.name: marker-sweep
motion.purpose: Highlighter sweep across the target heading; off under reduced motion.

components.name: Code Field
components.description: Solid navy band for every code block.
components.css: .ds-code { background: #002a42; color: #f3f7fa; font-family: ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 14px; padding: 16px 20px; margin: 0; border-radius: 0; } .ds-kw { color: #7fd0dc; } .ds-str { color: #9fd8b8; }

components.name: Target Heading
components.description: Heading the reader jumped to, under the highlighter.
components.css: .ds-target { font-family: Nexa, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-size: 28px; letter-spacing: -0.02em; color: #0d1d2b; background: #ffe45c; display: inline; }

components.name: Warning Admonition
components.description: Source-slip callout with a state-coloured top edge.
components.html:
Warning

Quantity searches match on the coded unit as stored.
components.css: .ds-adm { background: #eef1f4; border-top: 3px solid #9a5b00; padding: 16px; font-family: 'Source Serif 4', Georgia, serif; color: #0d1d2b; } .ds-adm-h { font-family: Nexa, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 11.5px; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #9a5b00; margin-bottom: 6px; } .ds-adm p { margin: 0; }

components.name: Page Action Button
components.description: Copy page split button above each doc.
components.css: .ds-pa { font-family: Nexa, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 13px; color: #3e4f5e; background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #cfd7df; border-radius: 4px; padding: 5.6px 9.6px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease, color 150ms ease; } .ds-pa:hover { background: #eef1f4; color: #0d1d2b; } .ds-pa:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #003b5c; outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Sidebar Link
components.description: Current page as a sheet pulled from the stack.
components.html: SearchOperations
components.css: .ds-nav { background: #eef1f4; padding: 8px; font-family: Nexa, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; } .ds-nav-a { display: block; padding: 6px 12px; color: #3e4f5e; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-a:hover { background: rgb(0 59 92 / 0.06); } .ds-nav-a.is-active { background: #ffffff; color: #003b5c; font-weight: 700; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(13 29 43 / 0.08); }

narrative.overview: The docs are the reference material behind Tribe Health's cited letter. Each doc page is a square-edged white sheet laid on a cool desk; Ink Navy owns whole regions; Highlighter yellow appears only where evidence is in focus. Dark mode is the night desk: the same world under navy.
keyCharacteristics: Nexa chrome, serif prose, mono for code only
Square edges; 4px only on small controls

rules.name: The Yellow Means Evidence Rule
rules.body: Highlighter marks only what the reader is looking at: a target heading, a search hit, a selection.

rules.name: The Fields Not Accents Rule
rules.body: Navy appears as whole regions or as the colour of a link or active item, never as tinted boxes, pills or icon tiles.

rules.name: The Night Desk Rule
rules.body: Dark mode rebuilds the same world under navy; it is not a grey theme.

rules.name: The Chrome Speaks Nexa Rule
rules.body: Chrome is Nexa, prose is serif, and never the reverse.

dos: Do use the --th-* tokens in src/css/custom.css for every colour.
Do keep all prose on the sheet and all chrome on the desk.
Do give every custom interactive element a 2px --th-focus outline at 2px offset.
Do check new colours in both the day desk and the night desk.
donts: Don't use Highlighter yellow for anything but evidence in focus.
Don't add rounded cards, tinted callout pills, gradients, glass or coloured side stripes.
Don't put uppercase labels above headings; labels are document chrome only.
Don't set prose in Nexa or chrome in the serif.
Don't show real patient data in examples, screenshots or diagrams; synthetic only.
